title: Notes application (revised)
summary: Local notes app with create/list/search/delete using SQLite and standard library HTTP server - revised per requirements
features: Create note with title and body
risks: SQLite file corruption if interrupted during write
Browser XSS if body not escaped
Port already in use by another process
Duplicate titles allowed without conflict handling

tasks.title: Initialize project structure and SQLite database (no timestamps)
tasks.instructions: Create app.py with SQLite schema for notes table (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT). Implement GET /health returning {"status":"ok"}. Add basic error handling. Create server function create_server(host, port) returning HTTPServer.

tasks.title: Implement note creation endpoint
tasks.instructions: Add POST /api/notes endpoint accepting JSON with title and body. Validate inputs (non-empty title). Insert into SQLite without timestamp. Return 201 with created note object containing id, title, body only. Allow duplicate titles.

tasks.title: Implement list notes endpoint
tasks.instructions: Add GET /api/notes returning JSON array of all notes sorted by id descending. Each note includes id, title, body (no created_at). Ensure response is valid JSON with proper encoding.

tasks.title: Implement search notes endpoint
tasks.instructions: Add GET /api/notes/search?q= query parameter. Filter notes where title contains query string (case-insensitive). Return matching notes as JSON array. Handle empty query by returning all notes.

tasks.title: Implement delete note endpoint
tasks.instructions: Add DELETE /api/notes/{id} endpoint. Accept note id from URL path. Delete from SQLite and return 200 with {"deleted":true}. Return 404 if not found.

tasks.title: Create HTML interface for browser access
tasks.instructions: Create static HTML served at GET / with form to create notes, list display, search box, delete buttons. Use proper escaping for user input (html.escape). Include basic CSS for usability. Ensure all endpoints are accessible from UI.

tasks.title: Integration tests and final validation including restart persistence
tasks.instructions: Create main block accepting --host and --port arguments. Run server with http.server module. Verify all endpoints work: create note, list notes, search, delete. Test persistence by creating a note, restarting server against same database file, retrieving it before deleting. Ensure health check passes.
